pieces.Text: A sahkil's natural weapons, as well as any weapon it wields, are treated as though they had the ghost touch weapon special ability.

All sahkils have a gaze attack that instills dread in those they look upon. This gaze attack has a range of 30 feet (though when a sahkil is on the Ethereal Plane, it functions against creatures on the Material Plane that can see ethereal creatures), and can be negated by a Will save-the exact effects caused by a particular sahkil's look of fear depend on the type of sahkil. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.
Many sahkils can shift between the Ethereal Plane and the Material Plane as a move action. This ability is otherwise identical to ethereal jaunt (CL 15th).
Whenever a sahkil casts a spell or uses a spell-like ability or effect with the emotion or fear descriptors that allows a saving throw, the DC is increased by 2.

) for purposes of spells or effects that call outsiders, receive a +
bonus on Charisma checks to break free of planar binding spells and similar effects, and their SR counts as if it were 5 higher (
) for the purpose of breaking free of planar binding spells and similar effects.
